**P1 — Do not declare isolation while invocation work remains live**

Cleanup considers a request drained once its wrapper returns, ignoring active root/task events. If the stubborn case fails before its dedicated residual poll, cleanup can pass while the non-cooperative child still occupies the shared executor and emits late work, contaminating subsequent cases. Require balanced task/root exits and no post-return SDK activity before declaring quiescence; add a stubborn failure-path test.
